original.statement: In v2.0.0, Crossplane core no longer logs "Composition Functions are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-functions flag will be removed in a future release." What this means for the --enable-composition-functions flag is not stated.

decision.reason: The removed v1.20.1 line [ev-2875a348b5d7] is a notice about the --enable-composition-functions flag. It is gone in v2.0.0 [ev-59d22c21eec4]. Whatever the flag's fate turns out to be in v2.0.0, only environments whose Crossplane workloads pass that flag can be affected, so cli-flag{--enable-composition-functions, set} is the right exposure condition. The excerpts themselves are empty and the change and consequence are still undetermined, so confidence is low.
